name: plugin-packaging
description: Plugin troubleshooting for a skills-only Claude plugin: plugin install failures, skills not loading, or bundled files it cannot find. Use when colleagues cannot install a package that works locally, a plugin.json manifest points at the wrong directory, plugin dependencies do not resolve, or broken references appear after you share it. Paste the manifest, a file inventory, configs, errors or an install transcript. Get the failing path or declaration, corrected file text or an authorized local repair, and a receipt of what the install evidence shows. Not for new scaffolding, improving one skill’s answers, or team administration.
